name: Taffy
notes: Zephyr rebuilt: it now plays real chords. Each note has a clear body with thin upper harmonics that shimmer in and out (never out of tune with the chord), plus a soft pitched hiss; the noise burst at the start is gone, so the start is a gentle swell. The three settings are now Zephyr edge, air and shimmer. The saw sounds are much softer by default: Saw softness is now 8 and uses a steeper slope, which takes most of the zing off the top.
